Package pt.pa.model

Class TransportMap

java.lang.Object
pt.pa.patterns.observer.Subject
pt.pa.model.TransportMap
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observable
public class TransportMap extends Subject
Represents a transportation network with stops and routes linking them.

  • Field Details

    • NUMBER_OF_TOP_CENTRALIZED_STOPS

      public static final int NUMBER_OF_TOP_CENTRALIZED_STOPS
      The number of top centralized stops to be retrieved. This constant defines the maximum number of stops that will be considered as the most centralized, based on the highest number of connected routes.

    • addRoute

      public com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Edge<Route,Stop> addRoute(Stop origin, Stop destination, Route route)
      Adds a route between two stops into the transportation network. The stops don't need to follow a specific order. Updates the unique transport modes present in the transport map. And notifies all transport map observers with the update.
      Parameters:
      origin - The destination stop.
      destination - The origin stop.
      route - The route to add.
      Returns:
      The added edge on the transportation map graph.
      Throws:
      com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.InvalidVertexException - If either stop is not part of the transport graph.
      com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.InvalidEdgeException - If the provided route already exists in the transport graph.

    • addRoute

      Adds a route between two stop vertices in the transportation network. The stop vertices don't need to follow a specific order. Updates the unique transport modes present in the transport map. And notifies all transport map observers with the update.

      com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.InvalidEdgeException - If the provided route already exists in the transport graph.

    • updateRouteMetric

      public void updateRouteMetric(Route route, String transportName, CostType costType, double newCost) throws InvalidTransportModeException
      Updates a transport metric for a specific transport mode on a route within a transport map. This method updates the metric value (cost) for a specified transport mode on a given route.
      Parameters:
      route - The route where the transport metric should be updated. This must not be null.
      transportName - The name of the transport mode whose metric should be updated. This must not be null or blank.
      costType - The type of metric (cost) that should be updated. This must not be null.
      newCost - The new cost value to be set. This value must be non-negative.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If any of the following conditions are met:
      • The provided route is null.
      • The provided transportName is null or blank.
      • The provided costType is null.
      com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.InvalidEdgeException - If no edge corresponding to the provided route exists in the transport map.
      InvalidTransportModeException - If the transport mode with the given transportName does not exist in the specified route.

    • stopCentralization

      public List<org.javatuples.Pair<Stop,Integer>> stopCentralization()
      Calculates the centralization of each stop in the transport map. The centralization is defined as the number of routes (edges) connected to a stop (vertex).

      The method returns a list of pairs where each pair consists of a stop and its centralization value, sorted in descending order of centralization.

      Returns:
      A list of pairs where each pair consists of a stop and its centralization value, sorted in descending order of centralization.

    • topCentralizedStops

      public List<org.javatuples.Pair<Stop,Integer>> topCentralizedStops(List<org.javatuples.Pair<Stop,Integer>> centralizationList)
      Retrieves the top 5 most centralized stops from the transport map. Centralized stops are those connected to the highest number of routes.

      If the provided centralization list is null, the method throws an IllegalArgumentException. The method returns a list of the top 5 pairs (or fewer if the list contains less than 5 stops) where each pair consists of a stop and its centralization value (connected routes).

      Parameters:
      centralizationList - A precomputed list of pairs where each pair consists of a stop and its centralization value, sorted in descending order of centralization. If null, the method calculates the list.
      Returns:
      A list of the top 5 pairs where each pair consists of a stop and its centralization value (connected routes).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the provided centralization list is null.

    • topCentralizedStops

      Returns:

    • findOptimalPath

      public List<org.javatuples.Triplet<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>,String,TransportMetrics>> findOptimalPath(com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> origin, com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> destination, Set<String> chosenTransports, CostType preferredCost)
      Finds the optimal path between two stop vertices, considering the specific preferred cost type and the chosen transports. This method uses a strategy for pathfinding to calculate the best route.
      Parameters:
      origin - The origin stop vertex from which the path calculation begins.
      destination - The destination stop vertex to which the path is calculated.
      chosenTransports - A set of transport names that are considered for the path.
      preferredCost - The preferred cost type to minimize or optimize for.
      Returns:
      A list of triplets, each containing a stop vertex, the transport mode used, and the transport metrics cost for that leg of the journey. The list represents the complete path from origin to destination, including all stops and routes.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - If no pathfinding strategy has been set for the transport map.
      InvalidStopException - If any of the stop vertices (origin or destination) are invalid.
      IllegalArgumentException - If any other arguments are invalid, such as empty chosen transports, or null cost type.

    • findStopsByDistance

      public Set<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>> findStopsByDistance(com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> origin, int numberOfStopsDistance)
      Finds a set of stop vertices that are at a specific distance (in terms of stops) from the origin vertex.

      Uses a Breadth-First Search (BFS) algorithm to explore the graph, keeping track of the current distance (breadth level). If the distance of 0 is provided, the origin vertex is returned.

      Parameters:
      origin - The stop vertex to start counting from.
      numberOfStopsDistance - The number of stops the set must be distant from the origin.
      Returns:
      A set of stop vertices found at the specified distance from the origin.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the number of stops distance is negative.
      com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.InvalidVertexException - If the origin vertex is not part of the transport map graph.

    • getUniqueTransports

      public Set<String> getUniqueTransports()
      Retrieves a set of unique transport modes present in the routes of the transport map. This method iterates through all the routes and collects the transport modes associated with each route, ensuring no duplicates by using a set.

      The method uses a HashSet to accumulate the transport modes. If a route has no transport modes, it is skipped.

      Returns:
      A set of unique transport mode names, or an empty set if no transport modes are found.
